products.description:
Sofa Construction & Materials:

✔ Sturdy Wooden Frame – Crafted from high-quality plywood, ensuring durability, strength, and long-lasting support.

✔ Premium Cushioning & Padding – High-density U Foam provides exceptional comfort, resilience, and shape retention for a cozy seating experience.

✔ Elegant Upholstery Options – Choose from a wide range of premium fabrics, including Rexin, velvet, linen, polyester, cotton, and microfiber, to complement your interior décor.

✔ Durable Legs & Base – Available in wood, metal, or stainless steel (SS) for a stable, stylish, and long-lasting foundation.


Customization Options:

  • Size & Shape: Available in various sizes, from compact loveseats to spacious sectional sofas.
  • Fabric & Color Choices: Customize your sofa with a variety of colors and textures to match your aesthetic.
  • Additional Features: Options like tufted designs, storage compartments, and recliner mechanisms are available upon request.

Care & Maintenance Tips:

  • Regular Cleaning: Vacuum upholstery weekly to remove dust and debris.
  • Spot Cleaning: Use a mild detergent and damp cloth for stains; avoid harsh chemicals.
  • Sunlight Protection: Keep the sofa away from direct sunlight to prevent fabric fading.
  • Leg & Frame Care: Tighten screws periodically and avoid excessive weight to maintain structural integrity.
